status: Conditional planning scenarios, not measured end-to-end cost bounds or probability intervals
rate_basis: Previously measured 16-vCPU x2iedn.4xlarge allocation including EBS and IPv4; live EC2 pricing API denied pricing:GetProducts. No current machine-price quote claimed.
limits: The busy-worker term assumes the measured CPU time transfers linearly to full depth and keeps 16 CPUs busy; it excludes initial NT24 screening/native alignments and all non-search work.

Other-worker-hours are assumptions covering acquisition, reference staging, native/control alignment, production adapters, filtering, duplicate marking, analysis and idle/inefficiency; they are not measurements.
Sensitive BLAST rates span two existing panels with different scheduling and query composition; neither predicts production merged-read costs reliably.
Merged/joined production queries differ from the 464 separately searched mates. The 20-read cap is per species/group, not a global budget bound.
Deduplication, candidate density and data availability can change at full depth. Paired input totals and object sizes must be checked.
Full RUN QC/profiling branches and final downstream outputs are required for a literal end-to-end claim; any omitted branches must be explicitly named.
First sample is a full-depth engineering and costing gate within the frozen 10; do not change selection based on its biology.
No assumption of authorization to exceed the current cap; terminate/preserve before the hard spend boundary.
